title: leafyserver
tagline: A personal homelab that started as a box for Jellyfin and grew into a full self-hosted stack.

highlights.title: Media
highlights.description: Streams movies and shows, with a request system for new titles.

highlights.title: Gaming
highlights.description: Dedicated Minecraft, Terraria and Hytale servers managed through Pelican Panel.

highlights.title: Office
highlights.description: Private cloud storage plus shared docs, sheets and slides.

highlights.title: Utility
highlights.description: Private search with SearXNG, local smart home automation and a local AI chat assistant.

highlights.title: Infrastructure
highlights.description: Services run in Docker, with Cloudflare, monitoring, networking and the VPN tying the setup together.
